events.description: CIA information report (DTG 171601Z JUN 97) issued on Bin Ladin's financial support to the Egyptian IG, with Algerian and Libyan extremists also in the title.
As of early 1996 the IG received funding from a number of donors, including Islamic extremist financiers.
CIA information report disseminated on Usama bin Ladin's financial support to the Egyptian al-Gama'at al-Islamiyya and Algerian and Libyan extremists (date-time group 171601Z JUN 97).
As of early 1996, the IG received funding from a number of donors, including Islamic extremist financiers; bin Ladin received donations on its behalf from wealthy donors.

relationships.detail: Bin Ladin receives donations on behalf of the IG from wealthy donors, so the IG is funded through him.
